text:
Rina (Growth): Proposal: run a small PLG test called 'Activation Canvas' — combine micro-credits + 3 curated prompt templates + tailored launch posts for webinar attendees. Goal: improve 'time-to-first-meaningful-request' within 7 days by ~10%. Thoughts?

Omar: Sounds good. Which cohorts? webinar registrants (warm) and recent signups (cold warmers)?

Rina (Growth): Start with 600 users: 60% webinar RSVPs, 40% recent signups. Split into 3 creative arcs: 'Speed-to-Value', 'Demo-in-10', 'Use-Case Playbook'. Each gets 35 tokens, TTL=7d.

Leah: I'll own the copy + launch posts. Short headline variants for social/web: A) "Ship a feature in 10 prompts" B) "From idea to demo in minutes". In-console micro-tooltips to surface the relevant template.

Diego: Routing plan: tag cohorts `canvas_web` and `canvas_signup`. Exclusions: paid customers, credits_30d, high-usage. Posting config to #eng-infra.

Maya: Metrics: primary = pct with >=1 meaningful request within 24h and day7. Secondary = avg tokens/use and 14-day retention. Also track which creative arc yields fastest first request. @ops-bot pull baseline for last 30d.

ops-bot: Baseline query queued: `canvas_baseline_v1`. Result link: https://internal.data/reports/canvas_baseline_v1 (internal). ETA 20m.

Rina (Growth): Measurement: randomize assignment 1:1:1 across arcs. Send Day0 email + in-console surfacing, Day3 reminder nudge. Also run a quick 1-question in-app probe to 30 users on day2.

Leah: Draft email copy (variant):
```
Subject: 35 starter tokens — try these 3 templates
Hi {{first_name}}, here are 3 templates to get value fast. Tokens expire in 7 days. [CTA: Try templates]
```
Will attach templates and Figma mocks.

Diego: Draft routing snippet (ops will implement):
```
experiment: activation_canvas_v1
cohorts: ["canvas_web","canvas_signup"]
credit: 35
ttl_days: 7
exclusions: ["paid_customer","credit_30d","high_usage"]
```
Posting to infra after a quick review.

Maya: I'll build the dashboard and set a regression alert. If lift >=10% at day7 we scale to 3k users.

Rina (Growth): Owners: Rina (strategy), Leah (creative), Diego (routing), Maya (analysis). Check-in Thurs 9am PT. Rolling next week pending infra signoff. :rocket:
